summary: Phase 1 (Stats Table, Role Fit, Dossier, Transfer Market, Club Analysis, market/club feature gates, Downloads single-button) tested backend (new pytest file test_fmcc_stage18_analysis.py, 22 tests + regression of features_gate and stage16_extras) and frontend (Playwright at 1920 and 390). Almost everything works: no ca/pa/ability/potential keys anywhere in /api/analysis/* payloads (checked recursively); 40 roles; dossier six factors; similar/cheaper(<=60%)/younger rules hold; role weights PUT/GET/DELETE with 422/404 validation and change the fit; 409 gates for market/club; nav lock; all Stats Table quick filters, AND/OR, top % conditions, sort, columns, saved views, CSV, role weights dialog; dossier, compare dialog with add/remove; Transfer Market lists, notes, rankings filters and summary, tm-row opens dossier; Club Analysis todo/positions/ideas and Look link prefilter (group=GK); Downloads shows only 4 packs with Download & install / Waiting for the download (Cancel works) / Installed. Found 1 functional bug (My league changes always empty), 1 spec gap (only 86 unique columns, spec says 100+), 1 mobile layout bug in Club Analysis.

critical.issue: my_league is always null, so the 'Since your last save → My league' tab is always empty. In market(), rows is filtered to `not r['own']` BEFORE computing my_league = next(r.league for r in rows if r.club == c.club_name), so no row can match. Own players also get league 'Your league' (snapshot players have no league in _world), so even using the own rows would give the placeholder. Verified via API: my_league=None while changes contain 5 leagues.

minor.issue: Spec says 100+ columns. meta returns 92 column entries and only 86 unique ones (Physical repeats 5 attributes already in Attributes). Add more per-90/General columns (e.g. goals/assists per 90, wage, height, pass %, etc.) to reach 100+.

Own-squad players get league 'Your league' (placeholder) instead of the real league name. It shows as a league option in the Stats Table / Rankings and changes the 'Club' value factor and 'One league' compare for own players.
Not gated by need('scouting') while /meta and /table are; with scouting off the dossier still loads (inconsistent but probably fine because the dossier opens from market/club pages too).

Frontend slider sends the full weights object built from the stale cached `saved` value on every input event; fast keyboard/drag sends many PUTs which can race (pressing ArrowRight 8 times from 1 ended at 3, not 5). Debounce or send a single attribute and $set roles.key.attr on the server.

ui_bugs.issue: Cards are wider than the viewport: the 'Look' buttons and the Where to strengthen table columns are clipped at the right. The outer `display:grid` container grows to the table's min-content width. Fix: gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(0,1fr)' (or minWidth:0 on the cards).

integration_issues.flow: Transfer Market → Since your last save → My league
integration_issues.issue: Always shows 'Nothing yet' because the backend's my_league is null (see backend issue)

issues: Roles with no without-ball attributes (Enganche, Poacher) show 'without —%'. Drop the % when the value is null.
Radar axes and table rows use raw keys (npxg, xa, kp, progp, prr, passc) instead of labels from meta. passc shows 100.00 for both players, which looks wrong or is a % metric mixed with counts.

Club options aren't narrowed by the chosen league, so league + club easily gives '0 players · total £0 · average age — · 0 not from the main nation'. Rankings and lists mix men's and women's players with no gender filter.
Locked 'Transfer Market' subtitle wraps to 2 lines because of the lock icon (other items are 1 line).

'top %' / 'bottom %' conditions always use percentiles over the whole save (rows), not the 'Compare against' base. That may be intended, but the user may expect it to follow the Compare against choice.

action_items: Fix /api/analysis/market my_league: compute it from the career's own league (give own players their real league in _world rather than 'Your league'), before filtering out own rows
Add enough columns in /api/analysis/meta to reach 100+ unique columns (spec)
Fix Club Analysis mobile overflow (grid minmax(0,1fr))
Use meta labels in the compare radar/table; show '—' rather than '—%' in dossier roles
Optional: debounce role-weight slider PUTs; narrow Rankings club options by league; gender filter in rankings
critical_code_review_comments: analysis_api.market(): my_league lookup uses the non-own rows, so it can never match the user's club

_world() rebuilds the whole world (fits for every player x 40 roles + model) on every request for /table, /player, /similar, /market, /club; the dossier and each Similar tab click recompute everything. Fine for the SAMPLE size, but it may be slow on a real save with many thousands of players. Cache per snapshot id plus weights version.
dossier(): uses a list comprehension side-effect pattern `hist.append(...) if ... else None` inside a for loop; readable but fragile
StatsTable test(): the first line has a redundant ternary (both branches get(r, c.field))
RoleWeights builds payload from cached `saved` → lost updates under rapid input

rca of the issue: My league empty: analysis_api.py market() line 266 `rows = [r for r in rows if not r['own']]`, then line 284 searches those rows for club == c['club_name'] → always None. Also _world() sets own league to p.get('league') or 'Your league', and snapshot players have no league field. Fix: derive my_league from the career/snapshot (e.g. league of the club in the pool/world_months) and give own rows that league.
